title: OpenAI Provider: Test Harness
description:
Implement the full OpenAI provider test harness.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Plan: docs/plans/03-provider-openai-test-harness.md (all sections)

Key deliverables:
- Property tests P1-P6 (stream ordering, tool delta convergence, usage/cost, multi-tool index isolation, ModelCompat independence, error classification)
- Stub server tests S1 + fault injection F1-F6
- Oracle tests O1-O3 (cross-implementation, cross-provider, compat request format)
- Deterministic simulations S1-S4 (event FSM, multi-tool interleaved, reasoning+text+tool, usage positions)
- Benchmarks B1-B6 (SSE, allocs, tool JSON, stream overhead, message conversion, compat flag resolution)
- Stress/soak ST1-ST3, Security SEC1-SEC3
- Coverage >= 85%

Depends on: Shared Test Infrastructure (aiag-jj7.1), OpenAI Core (aiag-mac.1)
